description:
This project is a short personal work created during my free time over the course of one week. After several months without opening Blender due to intensive CPGE studies, I wanted to take advantage of the holidays to practice again and avoid losing my skills.
The main goal of this project was to achieve a high level of photorealism (even if not perfect), focusing on an interior brutalist architecture atmosphere. A significant part of the work was dedicated to the concrete materials, which were entirely created using procedural textures.

Workflow
- Modeling and asset creation with Blender.
- Procedural concrete texturing developed entirely within Blender.
- Rendering with Cycles - EXR (Linear Rec.709) – 2000×3000 px – approximately 1 hour per frame with 1024 samples.
- Compositing and post-production carried out with DaVinci Resolve.

PC configuration
- 16 GB DDR5
- Intel Core i7-12700H
- NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050
